frozen_gate.admission_conditions: n<=32, clauses<=512, zero source unit clauses, at least one complementary binary wedge and >=25% binary density
frozen_gate.soundness: Every derived clause needs independent CaDiCaL entailment check under negation; unfinished probe yields no inference
frozen_gate.fallback: Original source strong CDCL if gate skips or preparation is interrupted

observations.large_cases: On n18 MAJ3-K4, generated n220/240 SAT and generated n220/240 UNSAT, adaptive gate avoids the old ~7001 charged clause visits but remains slower or statistically unclear vs pure CDCL.
observations.negative_control_correction: Original CI negative test incorrectly treated (1 OR 2),(1 OR 3),(NOT 1 OR 2) as wedge-free; this formula entails 2. Replaced with genuinely wedge-free example; corrected CI passed both runners.
observations.result: No proven whole-pipeline acceleration vs raw CaDiCaL or Glucose4

epistemic_restrictions: All benchmarks are public previously used instances and synthetic mechanism controls, NOT external blind held-out data
Statistical paired bootstraps are descriptive on public cases; do not claim externally generalizable significance
Process-wide RSS is not per-arm peak RSS; memory requirement remains open
New portable UNSAT certificates were not generated or independently replayed
Logical unit yield is not equivalent to time-profitability
Physical retrocausality, tachyons, quantum advantage, and P=NP not established
No Demiurge live authority, no C023 production modification
Original TIME-SAT-PARTIAL-001 negative findings retained verbatim

decision.next_research: Externally sealed hard CNF sources and zero-cost-ish direct structural unit extraction versus modern CDCL built-in preprocessing; measure isolated per-arm RSS and independently verified UNSAT proofs
